title: no forced input patterns or masks
rule: No forced input patterns / masks — `pattern` + JS that blocks non-matching keystrokes fails foreign phone numbers, “call afternoons only”, and letter names. Password-style exact format is the exception and must be in the description, not a vanishing placeholder. Dual-cite Spectrum format-valid icon (format-match, not a mask); do not collapse. `inputmode="numeric"` is fine.
pass_when: No HTML `pattern` and no mask that strips keys or jumps the caret on flexible fields; format lives in a description; `inputmode="numeric"` may be present. Password exact-match (described) is the named exception.
fail_when: HTML `pattern` and/or JS that strips keys or jumps the caret.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Spectrum format-valid icon as this ban; placeholder as the format instruction (placeholder lock); `inputmode="numeric"` as a fail; don’t-reject-variants as this row.
